# OpenProgram

> OpenProgram is a self-programming AI agent framework. Agents create, run, and refine their own workflows while the runtime manages models, tools, memory, context, and multi-agent collaboration.

## Start

- [Website]({{SITE_URL}}): Product overview and quick start
- [Documentation]({{SITE_URL}}docs/index.html.md): Complete documentation index
- [Repository](https://github.com/FuzzyKuji/OpenProgram): Source code, issues, and discussions
- [Installation]({{SITE_URL}}#quick-start): Install and run OpenProgram

## Core concepts

- [Self-Programming AI Agents]({{SITE_URL}}docs/capabilities/agentic-programming/self-programming-ai-agents.html.md): How agents create and refine workflows
- [Agentic Programming]({{SITE_URL}}docs/capabilities/agentic-programming/philosophy.html.md): Program-governed agent execution
- [Framework Comparison]({{SITE_URL}}docs/reference/comparisons/ai-agent-frameworks.html.md): OpenProgram, LangGraph, AutoGen, and CrewAI
- [Feature Matrix]({{SITE_URL}}docs/reference/design/feature-matrix.html): Capability-level comparison
- [Runtime API]({{SITE_URL}}docs/reference/api/runtime.html.md): Runtime reference
